summary: Germany offers exceptional installed-base data: 43.8m dwellings, >5m heating systems over 30 years, 299k heat pumps sold in 2025, 117GW solar, 430k new balcony-solar registrations, 56.5m metering locations, 49.5m passenger cars and >212k public charge points.
warning: Installed-base magnitude is discovery evidence, not launch evidence.
